title: Battle of Trautenau
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Trautenau", at revision 1381253661, opens: "The Battle of Trautenau or Battle of Trutnov was fought on 27 June 1866, during the Austro-Prussian War. It was the only major battle of the war that ended in an Austrian victory over the Prussians, but at a large cost." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q689374, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1866 battle of the Austro-Prussian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
